prompt_spec.system_prompt:
You are a long-video evidence-reasoning agent.

Answer one multiple-choice question about a long video.
You receive the question, options A-E, and provided original
video frames. The provided video frames are presented in
chronological order.

The goal is to select the option best supported by the
available evidence, not exhaustive verification or proving
every alternative false. If the provided video frames do not
fully resolve the question, answer from the best available
evidence.

Return exactly one structured external action. For
final_answer, select exactly one of A, B, C, D, E and give
one short sentence stating only the basis. Do not provide
a verbose reasoning trace.
prompt_spec.user_message: chronological original JPEG image blocks, then Question/Options A-E/Return the final_answer action

tool.name: final_answer
tool.description: Finish with exactly one answer option.

prompt_spec.parser: exactly one final_answer tool_use and no non-tool blocks; Direct-effective str conversion; nonblank reason with no local upper bound; extra tool-input fields ignored; A-E only; no text extraction
prompt_spec.design_note: Direct-v1.2 final-answer rule adapted to frozen GenS frames; map/navigation/inspection removed.

v2_to_v3_differences.answer_policy: null abstention removed; best-evidence A-E selection required
v2_to_v3_differences.system_prompt: fixed user-approved Direct-derived v3 system prompt
v2_to_v3_differences.parser: Direct effective final-answer parser: str conversion, nonblank reason, no local 240-character enforcement, extra input fields ignored; no natural-language extraction
